owner: original powerhouse-content-orchestrator + existing bg_social_lus_* one-variable experiment owner
root_cause: Original bg_social_lus_meting hardcoded bedrijfgeheugen social_posts and social_metric_snapshots for both channels. Production personal LinkedIn original publisher stored recent posts and reactions-only provider snapshots in canonical tenant, with views_unavailable=true and metrics.reactions (not likes, comments or impressions). The loop therefore had 0 measured personal posts even though 17 recent canonical personal posts and 14 matching snapshot records existed. Original cycle also classified missing impressions as zero and evaluator promoted +25% before-after as a winner even if baseline was empty; evaluation wrote experiment_variant application records for all posts without per-post proof.
fix: Replace exact original SQL function definitions through one protected migration: choose canonical tenant only for personal LinkedIn and bedrijfsgeheugen for company; join snapshot with exact tenant+post; interpret numeric reactions including 0 as observed data; preserve absent impressions as NULL; adjust descriptive cycle verdict accordingly; reject experiment uplift without factual measured baseline, keep inconclusive before-after as TESTING not PROMOTED, and write evidence-limited TESTING records into the existing social_learnings store, while stopping unproven experiment_variant applications for every observed post.
prevention_rule: A learning decision is admissible only if source tenant, metric schema, provider observation, cohort, baseline, denominator and actual application lineage are checked before any hypothesis, uplift or promotion. Missing impressions are unknown, not zero. A raw before/after comparison without matched controls is descriptive, not proof of causal improvement. Use original ONE BRAIN incident, original owner and protected regression.

invariants: no false application without exact variant provenance

terminal_rule: Exact-head protected Required + CodeQL + full BRAIN, original migration authority applies migration to canonical Supabase and pg_get_functiondef readback matches, original run bg_social_lus_cyclus observes actual canonical personal reactions, no invented uplift/applications, subsequent real provider-linked variant/effect remains independently EVIDENCE_DUE.
